person_note: The controlling narration is anonymous and omniscient third person across the novel's historical episodes. The long q01048 passage independently demonstrates sustained external narration, while the publisher's opening and a scholarly whole-book structural analysis agree. q01052 is a genuine but isolated first-person authorial writing-moment intrusion; because the structural source explicitly identifies an anonymous omniscient base narrator and no framework or sustained first-person section, that aside does not make the novel alternating. Universal we in q01037 and first- or second-person character speech are nondiagnostic. The main residual uncertainty is the exact local placement of q01052, but no researched source describes an alternate first-person narrative strand.
